statements.__comment: Create HAS relationship from lambda functions to the associated ECR image. Accounts are owned through the AWSOrganization; ECRImage.id is the image digest (indexed). ECRImage is shared by every account that pushed the same digest, so the image must be in one of this account's repositories: a digest seen only in another tenant's repository is never linked.
statements.query:
MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(aa:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(lambda:AWSLambda) 
 WHERE lambda.codesha256 IS NOT NULL 
 MATCH (aa)-[:RESOURCE]->(:ECRRepository)-[:REPO_IMAGE]->(:ECRRepositoryImage)-[:IMAGE]->(e:ECRImage{id: 'sha256:' + lambda.codesha256}) 
 WITH DISTINCT lambda, e 
 MERGE (lambda)-[r:HAS]->(e) 
 SET r.lastupdated = $UPDATE_TAG
